correctness.rationale: Direct graph has 20 vertices, 30 edges, and dissociation faces precisely vertex subsets inducing maximum degree≤1 (equivalent to forbidding each length-2 path). Independent enumeration from induced degree and forbidden triples agreed on all 2²⁰−1 nonempty masks, with 53,670 faces and f-vector (20,190,1080,3975,9624,15050,14340,7505,1760,126). Deterministic 20-pivot matching yielded 26,823 pairs, one critical vertex and 23 critical 7-cells; independent full 335,460 directed-cover-edge DAG topological-sort visited 53,670 faces, so Forman integral Morse collapse yields wedge 23 S^7. For arbitrary n≥3, invariant faces are unions of antipodal pairs indexed by independent sets of C_n; oriented simplex sign gives reduced Lefschetz -I(C_n;-1)=-2cos(nπ/3). At n10 this is +1, and reduced H7 trace is −1, yielding +/− dimensions 11/12. No integral eigensublattice splitting asserted.
residual_risks: The finite homotopy proof applies only n=10; no other-length homotopy assertion.

value.rationale: The Möbius ladder is a canonical highly symmetric cubic graph; its natural nonflag dissociation complex at 20 vertices has a genuinely nontrivial exact integral sphere wedge with an exhaustive acyclic matching. The uniform antipodal Lefschetz formula yields rational representation data invisible to face-count and ordinary Betti tables, motivating further equivariant classification.

limitations: Integral wedge at M20 is not asserted equivariantly, nor for all n.
